name: bar-chart
title: BarChart
description: A value per category, as bars: the analytical card's second form after <Sparkline> (a value over time). Carries its own scale, grid, legend and hover readout, and reads as a table to a screen reader. Reach for <Meter> when there is one value against one target, and for a <Table> when the numbers are compared exactly rather than at a glance. Copy: category labels are the categories' own names, shor
